verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an official remote, hosted MCP server with separate sandbox and live endpoints, OAuth or API-key auth, and a codemode tool interface (search, execute, report_missing_tool) covering the API. A separate official docs MCP server and plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI round this out, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably (all evidence is first-party, including the benchmark).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Paddle MCP server is a remote, hosted MCP server
The Paddle MCP server lets AI agents interact with your Paddle account.
Connect AI agents like Claude and Cursor directly to Paddle to work through complex flows in seconds.
